description: Troubleshooting procedure for diagnosing the detection of an incorrect marking pattern on assembled parts.

box_1.text: Were the parts with the wrong marking pattern made during regular production?

box_2.text: Read out the part ID code of the relevant parts.

box_3.text: Notify the quality assurance team and remove all parts with the wrong marking pattern if necessary.

box_4.text: Is the vision inspection system on?

box_5.text: Check in the deselection menu on the operator control interface whether the vision inspection system is still enabled.

box_7.text: Is the vision inspection system still properly set?

box_8.text: Have maintenance team check the vision inspection system for pattern recognition

box_9.text: Have maintenance team retrain the inspection model.

box_10.text: Notify quality assurance team and engineering team

box_11.text: Proceed with the non conformance notification procedure.
